tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged

confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Conta Premium Real-Debrid 30 Dias ( Oficial )' at R$ 25,00 and 'Conta Premium Real-Debrid ( 1 Ano - 365 Dias ) - Oficial' at R$ 150,00 (about R$ 0,41 per day), delivered as login data by email; the 90-day SKU is priced in the notes.

identity_cost.detail: Brazilian checkout; delivery by email; WhatsApp support. Payment rails not itemised on the product page.

reliability_note: The '100% satisfaction or your money back' line is a replacement promise from the seller, not a vendor refund: the vendor refunds only an unused account within 7 days.
